title: App shell
summary: The page frame: nav column, header, one scrolling body and footer. Header and footer stay put; safe-area insets are added on notched phones; a slotted control marked data-nav-toggle opens the side nav drawer.

props.name: navOpen
props.description: Drawer state, mirrors the side nav.

props.name: flush
props.description: Removes the body padding so a workspace, table or map sits edge to edge (the safe-area insets on a notched phone stay).

a11y: Landmarks: header, main content region and footer are exposed; only the body scrolls, so there is never a nested scrollbar; the skip link belongs first in the header slot.
mobile: The nav becomes a drawer; the body padding narrows; env(safe-area-inset-*) keeps content clear of the notch and home bar.
